views.name: player_ratings
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.id AS player_id,
  p.player_fifa_api_id AS overall_rating
FROM Player AS p
views.description: Selects player ratings from the player table.

views.name: player_heights
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.height,
  p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
views.description: Selects player height and player name.

views.name: league_goals_2015_2016
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    l.name AS league_name,
    SUM(m.goal) AS total_goals
FROM
    Match AS m
JOIN
    League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE
    STRFTIME('%Y', m.date) = '2015' AND STRFTIME('%Y', m.date) = '2015'
GROUP BY
    l.name
views.description: Calculate total goals scored by each league in the 2015/2016 season.

views.name: match_league_goals
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    l.name AS league_name,
    SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS home_team_goals,
    SUM(m.away_team_goal) AS away_team_goals
FROM Match AS m
JOIN League AS l
    ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
views.description: Aggregate goals scored by each league in each match.

views.name: game_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    m."match_api_id" AS match_api_id,
    t1."team_api_id" AS home_team,
    t2."team_api_id" AS away_team,
    m."home_team_goal" AS home_team_goal,
    m."away_team_goal" AS away_team_goal,
    m."season" AS season
FROM
    Match AS m
JOIN
    Team AS t1 ON m."away_team_api_id" = t1."team_api_id"
JOIN
    Team AS t2 ON m."home_team_api_id" = t2."team_api_id"
WHERE
    m."season" = '2015/2016'
views.description: Selects all game events for the specified season.

views.name: goal_difference
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    m.id AS game_id,
    (m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal) AS goal_difference
FROM
    Match AS m
views.description: Calculates the goal difference for each game.

views.name: losses_by_team
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    t.team_short_name AS team_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN g.goal_difference < 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS loss_count
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Match AS m
    ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id OR t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
JOIN Goal_difference AS g
    ON m.id = g.game_id
GROUP BY t.team_short_name
views.description: Counts the number of losses (negative goal difference) for each team.

views.name: player_penalties
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_name,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN m.goal = '1' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS penalty_count
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Match AS m
  ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_X1
GROUP BY
  p.player_name
views.description: Aggregates penalty counts for each player.

views.name: team_buildUpPlaySpeed
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  tba.buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM team_attributes AS tba
views.description: Selects the buildUpPlaySpeed for each team.

views.name: league_match_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT league_id, count(*) AS match_count
FROM "Match"
GROUP BY league_id
views.description: Calculate the number of matches played for each league.

views.name: aggregate_match_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  T1.league_id,
  COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM Match AS T1
GROUP BY
  T1.league_id
ORDER BY
  match_count DESC
LIMIT 1
views.description: Determine the league with the maximum match count.

views.name: average_height
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  AVG(CAST(Player.height AS REAL)) AS average_height
FROM Player
views.description: Calculates the average height of the filtered players.

views.name: filter_buildUpPlaySpeed
views.body_sql:
SELECT t.team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes AS t
WHERE t.buildUpPlaySpeed BETWEEN 51 AND 59
views.description: Select teams where buildUpPlaySpeed falls between 51 and 59 inclusive.

views.name: players_filtered
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.id AS player_id,
  p.preferred_foot,
  p.date AS birthday
FROM Player_Attributes AS p
WHERE
  p.preferred_foot = 'left' AND p.date BETWEEN '1987-01-01' AND '1992-12-31'
views.description: Filters players based on preferred_foot and birthday.

views.name: league_goals_per_season
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    l.name AS league_name,
    SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM
    Match m
JOIN
    League l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY
    l.name
views.description: Calculate the total goals scored by each league across all seasons.

views.name: top_leagues_by_goals
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  l.name AS league_name,
  SUM(m.goal) AS total_goals
FROM Match AS m
JOIN League AS l
  ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY
  l.name
ORDER BY
  total_goals DESC
LIMIT 5
views.description: Rank leagues by total goals scored, returning the top 5.

views.name: average_long_shot
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  AVG(
    Match."shoton"
  ) AS "average_event_value"
FROM Match
WHERE
  Match."shoton" IS NOT NULL
views.description: Calculate the average value of long-shot events.
